input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form.
input.rationale: Section 11 satisfies the preferred position in full: transition obligations trigger on expiry or termination for any reason (11.1); Vendor must provide up to six months of transition assistance including knowledge transfer, export support and migration; Customer Data must be returned within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with metadata (11.2); and an authorized officer must certify secure deletion after return (11.3). Two points are more favourable to us than the playbook baseline and need no change: assistance is priced at the rates in the expiring Order Form rather than Vendor's then-current rates, and Vendor may not withhold Customer Data over a fee dispute. The only minor variance is that the 30-day return clock runs from Customer's request rather than from termination itself; because the trigger is within our control and deletion occurs only after we confirm successful return, this is noted rather than redlined. Section 10.1 preserves our Customer Data rights and nothing elsewhere (Sections 15, 16.3) permits earlier deletion.
